concerns.text: FR-001 references "See US‑1", but no identifier US‑1 is defined anywhere in the document; the user stories are titled "User Story 1" etc. This breaks traceability of requirements to user stories.
FR-004 cites "See US‑2", yet there is no US‑2 identifier; the adaptive scheduler is described in User Story 2. The cross‑reference is undefined.
FR-006 includes "See US‑3, FR‑009" but US‑3 does not exist; the statistical validation is covered by User Story 3.
FR-007 cites "See US‑3" which is undefined.

FR-008 references "See US‑3, FR‑011"; US‑3 is undefined, and FR‑011 is a separate requirement that duplicates the functionality of FR‑008 (both require leave‑one‑out cross‑validation of a quadratic model). This redundancy creates ambiguity about which requirement is authoritative.
FR-010 cites "See US‑2" which is undefined.
FR-011 repeats the leave‑one‑out cross‑validation requirement already stated in FR‑008, leading to potential duplication and confusion about expected implementation.

responses.response: Added a user‑story identifier US‑1 by appending “(See US‑1)” to User Story 1 heading so FR‑001’s cross‑reference resolves.
responses.what_changed: Modified User Story 1 heading to include ‘(See US‑1)’.

responses.response: Added a user‑story identifier US‑2 by appending “(See US‑2)” to User Story 2 heading so FR‑004 and FR‑010 references resolve.
responses.what_changed: Modified User Story 2 heading to include ‘(See US‑2)’.

responses.response: Added a user‑story identifier US‑3 by appending “(See US‑3)” to User Story 3 heading so FR‑006 reference resolves.
responses.what_changed: Modified User Story 3 heading to include ‘(See US‑3)’.

responses.response: No textual change needed beyond defining US‑3; FR‑007 now correctly points to an existing user story.
Removed duplicate FR‑011, updated FR‑008 to drop the FR‑011 reference, and added FR‑013 to explicitly define a fixed‑median baseline that avoids circularity.
responses.what_changed: Deleted FR‑011 entry; changed FR‑008 reference to ‘(See US‑3)’; added new FR‑013 requirement.

responses.response: With US‑2 now defined, FR‑010’s cross‑reference resolves.
responses.what_changed: No direct text change; resolved by adding US‑2 identifier (see internal_consistency-90a92bcd).
